column1: # --dynmul magnitude scan, round 2: narrowing in on dyn6's apparent sweet spot
# commit dbf7845). On both ntil-45.knf and ntil-47.knf, dyn6 had the best
# PAR-2, fewest timeouts, and much smaller median_plen/median_succ than
# dyn10/dyn0/dyn20 -- dyn3 restarted too eagerly (starving promising probes,
# more timeouts on the harder instance) and dyn20 over-extended (wasting
# budget on unproductive probes). This round brackets 6 tightly to pinpoint
# the true optimum. Everything else at compiled defaults.
# With dynmul>0 the static --cutoff is IGNORED (yals.c:5546-5549): the budget
# is purely dynamic -- each probe starts at 1000 flips and every probe-best
# improvement extends the deadline to D*(flips-so-far).
